subject: Sortable List: Converting an Input Binding to Output Binding

messages.author: 345c2051bc2163c4
messages.subject: Sortable List: Converting an Input Binding to Output Binding
parts:
I was able to follow the instructions to create a custom input binding. I am having a bit of trouble translating that to an Output Binding. My app can be seen here:
http://spark.rstudio.com/jazz12man/sortable_list/

Basically, I want to be able to dynamically define a subset of items from a master list, and then sort the subset in any order.

I got it to work when I hard-code the list in the UI, but I need help writing the function that creates the output binding. I understand that it won't work the way I have it presented below, that is primarily to show how I want it to work dynamically. I can't set up a gist at the moment, so the code is pasted below

Any help is much appreciated, thanks!

sortlist.css:
.sortable { list-style-type: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 250px; }
.sortable li { margin: 0 5px 5px 5px; padding: 5px; font-size: 1.2em; height: 1.5em; }
.sortable li { height: 1.5em; line-height: 1.2em; }
.ui-state-highlight { height: 1.5em; line-height: 1.2em; }
.sortable li:hover {
    cursor: pointer;
}

.sortable li.ui-sortable-helper{
    cursor: move;
}

sortlist.js
  $(function() {
    $( ".sortable" ).sortable({
      placeholder: "ui-state-highlight"
    });
    $( ".sortable" ).disableSelection();
  });

global.R
ulSort = function(inputId, list.items) {
  children.li = NULL
  for(i in 1:length(list.items)) {
    children.li[[i]] = tags$li(class="ui-state-default",list.items[[i]])
  }
  tagList(
    tagAppendChildren(tags$ul(id=inputId,
                              class="sortable"),
                      children.li)
    
  )
}

ui.R
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(  
  headerPanel("Sortable List",
              tags$head(
                tags$link(rel="stylesheet", href="http://code.jquery.com/ui/1.10.3/themes/smoothness/jquery-ui.css"),
                tags$script(src="http://code.jquery.com/jquery-1.9.1.js"),
                tags$script(src="http://code.jquery.com/ui/1.10.3/jquery-ui.js"),
                tags$link(rel="stylesheet", type="text/css", href="sortlist.css"),
                tags$script(src="js/sortlist.js"),
                tags$title("Sortable List")
              )
  ),
  
  sidebarPanel(
    h3("Select Items to add to list"),
    selectInput("additemstolist","(Hold 'ctrl' to select multiple items)",
                paste("Input to Server",1:10),selected=NULL,multiple=T),
    tags$style(type="text/css","#additemstolist {height: 200px}")
  ),
  
  mainPanel(
    h2("From UI (sortable):"),
    ulSort("fromUI",paste("From UI:",1:5)),
    tags$hr(),
    h2("From Server (dynamic, but not sortable):"),
    htmlOutput("ui_sortable_list")
    
  )
))

server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  output$ui_sortable_list = renderUI({
    if(length(input$additemstolist)>0) {
      ulSort("fromServer",input$additemstolist)  
    }
  })
})
